📜 OUR STORY & MISSION

Dedicated to Comic Books & Community

Our shop was built out of an enduring passion for sequential art and tabletop gaming. Whether you have been reading superhero titles for decades or are stepping into the world of manga and indie graphic novels for the first time, our goal is to provide a welcoming, friendly, and knowledgeable haven for all fans.

ORDERING ➔
📦 SUBSCRIPTIONS & SPECIAL ORDERS

SUBSCRIBER PULL-BOX & SPECIAL ORDERS!

Never miss an issue of your favorite ongoing series! Set up a free subscriber pull box with our store and enjoy tiered discounts and guaranteed weekly holds.

🛡️

Guaranteed Copies

Your subscribed titles and requested variant covers are automatically held behind the counter.

💰

Tiered Discounts

Subscribers save 10% on 5+ titles, 15% on 10+ titles, and up to 20% on 20+ monthly ongoing titles!

📬

Free Bag & Board

Every single issue placed in your subscriber box includes acid-free bags and boards at no extra charge.

💰 SUBSCRIBER DISCOUNT TIERS
  • 📌 1 to 4 Titles: Standard subscriber holds with free archival bag and board.
  • ⚡ 5 to 9 Titles: 10% discount on all weekly subscribed single issues.
  • 🌟 10 to 19 Titles: 15% discount on all weekly subscribed single issues.
  • 💎 20+ Titles: VIP Collector 20% discount on all ongoing subscriptions!
✉️ PICKUP & MAIL DELIVERY

In-store pickup is free at our counter during regular store hours. We also ship mail orders anywhere in the country with sturdy comic mailers and tracking.
